resources.string: Loading a receipt reads about 4 MB from disk, parses 120,000 CSV lines and hashes the file. Run it on the main thread and the app cannot draw until it finishes; run it on a worker thread and the main thread stays free. StrictMode watches the main thread while this screen is open.
The click handler reads, parses and hashes the file directly. The spinner stops, frames are skipped, and StrictMode reports the disk access and the slow call.
The same work runs in withContext(Dispatchers.Default). The main thread only starts it and shows the result, so the spinner keeps turning and StrictMode stays quiet.
Freezes when the main thread is busy
StrictMode violations on the main thread: %1$d
None yet. Load the receipt on the main thread to see some.
StrictMode reports at most 10 violations per main thread message. The first load writes the 4 MB file in many small writes, which use them all up, so the slow call only shows from the second load on.

Each step is wrapped in a trace section: %1$s, receipt.read, receipt.parse and receipt.checksum. Record a system trace in the Android Studio profiler or with Perfetto and the sections appear on the main thread in one mode and on a DefaultDispatcher worker in the other.
